selection.title: Wall and Opening Classification for Apartment Plan
missingFeatures: Interior and exterior wall extents are only partially represented by the selected solid bands and face-pairs; some perimeter and partition segments between these bands are not explicitly captured.
Possible window or large opening geometry on the long external walls is not explicitly modeled as window gaps.
Furniture outlines (e.g., beds/tables and the large shaded rectangle) have not been individually identified because their stroke IDs are ambiguous in the provided candidate set.
